title: Inverted Clamp FISH Ligation Protocol
author: Benjamin Emert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qnjdvcn

steps.title: Reconstitute oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Dissolve all inverted‑Clamp‑FISH arms, backbone oligos and adapters in nuclease‑free water to a final concentration of 400 µM. If the amount of backbone oligo is very low, reconstitute it to 200 µM and plan to use twice the volume of that stock in later reactions.

steps.title: Phosphorylate backbone oligos
steps.instruction: In a tube combine the following for each backbone oligo: 2× T7 DNA ligase buffer, 400 µM backbone oligo, T4 polynucleotide kinase, and nuclease‑free water to the desired final volume. Mix, place the tube in a thermal cycler (lid on) and incubate the PNK reaction overnight (≈8 h) or for a shorter period if preferred. Multiple backbone oligos (e.g., 30) can be phosphorylated together by scaling the reaction 2–3‑fold.

steps.title: Assemble ligation mixture
steps.instruction: To the phosphorylated backbone add 400 µM left arm, 400 µM right arm, 400 µM left adapter and 400 µM right adapter. Mix gently.

steps.title: Thermal cycling of ligation components
steps.instruction: Place the assembled mixture in a thermal cycler, heat to 95 °C for 5 minutes, then cool slowly to 12 °C at a rate of 0.1 °C / second.

steps.title: Add ligase and incubate
steps.instruction: Allow the tube to reach room temperature, then add T7 DNA ligase (amount as supplied by the manufacturer). Mix, briefly centrifuge to collect liquid, and incubate at room temperature overnight. If any oligos carry a fluorescent dye, perform the incubation in the dark.

steps.title: Purify ligated probes (Monarch column)
steps.instruction: Purify the ligation product using a Monarch DNA cleanup column as follows:

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL nuclease‑free water to the ligation reaction (the total volume can be scaled; ensure that 7 × the volume of binding buffer will be added later).
Add 350 µL binding buffer, mix, and apply the mixture to the Monarch column.
Centrifuge the column for 1 minute at 16,000 × g.
Without removing the column from the centrifuge, add 200 µL Monarch DNA wash buffer, spin for 1 minute at 16,000 × g.
Repeat the 200 µL wash step a second time (no need to discard flow‑through between washes).
Transfer the column to a clean 1.5 mL tube and centrifuge for 1 minute at 16,000 × g to remove residual wash buffer.
Place the column in a new clean tube, add 30 µL nuclease‑free water (volume can be adjusted; 30 µL typically yields 50–80 ng/µL of probe using an absorbance constant of 33 on a Nanodrop).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 16,000 × g to collect the eluted probes.

steps.title: Quantify probe concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the eluted ssDNA probes on a Nanodrop spectrophotometer, setting the absorbance constant to 33 for single‑stranded DNA.
